question: According to IBEF 2021, the Indian pharmaceutical industry ranks _____ in the world on the basis of volume.
solution:
The correct option is__** 3rd.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian Brand Equity Foundation:-**

 
 
• **It is a government of India initiative that works to promote the brand image and prestige of India. **
 
• IBEF was formed in 2003 and is headquartered in New Delhi.
 
• The mission of IBEF is to develop India as a global brand. It works to promote India's diversity, richness, and culture.
 
• IBEF also works to raise awareness of India and attract foreign investment.
 
• According to **IBEF 2021, **the Indian pharmaceutical industry ranks** 3rd **in the world on the **basis of volume.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian pharmaceutical industry:-**

 
 
• It is the largest provider of **generic drugs **globally and accounts for **20%** of the world's generic drug exports.
 
• India is also one of the** world's largest producers of vaccines**, supplying more than** 60% of vaccines globally**.
 
• The Indian pharmaceutical industry is expected to grow at a** CAGR of 11% t**o reach **USD 130 billion by 2030. **
